tools.name: get_astronomy_picture_of_the_day
tools.title: Astronomy Picture of the Day
tools.description: Get NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day: title, explanation and image/video URL. Optionally pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD, from 1995-06-16 onwards).

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_iss_position
tools.title: ISS live position
tools.description: Get the current position of the International Space Station: latitude, longitude, altitude (km), velocity (km/h) and daylight visibility.

tools.name: list_upcoming_launches
tools.title: Upcoming rocket launches
tools.description: List upcoming worldwide rocket launches with mission name, provider, launch pad, scheduled time (NET) and status.

limit.description: How many launches to return (1-30, default 10).

tools.name: list_space_news
tools.title: Latest space news
tools.description: List the latest spaceflight and astronomy news articles with title, source, publish date, summary and link.

limit.description: How many articles to return (1-30, default 10).

search.description: Optional keyword to filter article titles.

tools.name: get_mars_rover_photos
tools.title: Mars rover photos
tools.description: Get the latest raw images from a NASA Mars rover (perseverance or curiosity), with camera name, sol and image URL.

rover.description: Which rover's raw image feed to read.

limit.description: How many photos to return (1-25, default 10).
